fields.FIR_Description: A online complaint dated 2026-04-12 states that members of a chit group near Nallur Nagar Main Street reported that the organiser stopped payouts, with the complainant owed about Rs. 1,85,000, on 2026-04-09 at approximately 13:10. Deepak Muthu submitted the complaint online using the mobile number 9000000404. Suspicion was reportedly directed towards Senthil Natarajan, using the number 9000000262. The complainant mentioned the account SYN-ACC-100005 as the destination of the transfer. Padmini Raj (9000000032) noticed the incident and may be able to provide a statement. The complainant mentioned transaction records, a witness statement and a bank transaction reference.
fields.Evidence_Mentioned: Transaction record; Witness statement; Bank transaction reference
fields.Modus_Operandi: Chit contributions reportedly collected in cash and through transfers.
fields.Keywords: chit fund, financial fraud, main street, transaction record, suspect, mobile number, receiving account, witness
